title: Sequencing: gallery panels
bodyMd:
Five information panels are mounted from left to right, each in one position.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Origins, Trade, Ritual, Change, Legacy.

- Origins must precede Legacy.
- Exactly 2 other items must occur between Trade and Change.
- Ritual must not be in position 1.
- Origins and Ritual must not occupy consecutive positions.
